crossRefs.note: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not allow anyone to go out or come in to…
Moreover Yahweh will raise up a king for himself over Israel, who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day!…
His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in…
His servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.
In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped…
Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

translations.web: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
translations.bsb: Then Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against Nadab, and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon of the Philistines while Nadab and all Israel were besieging the city.
translations.kjv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
translations.asv: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.
